+    @staticmethod
+    def _valid_time_stamp(timestamp):
+        """Return a valid ZIP timestamp tuple, or the ZIP epoch for invalid dates."""
+        epoch = (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
+        match = re.fullmatch(
+            r'([0-9]{4})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})\.([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})', timestamp
+        )
+        if match is None:
+            return epoch
+
+        year, month, day, hour, minute, second = (int(component) for component in match.groups())
+        if (not 1980 <= year <= 2107 or not 1 <= month <= 12 or not 0 <= hour <= 23 or
+                not 0 <= minute <= 59 or not 0 <= second <= 59):
+            return epoch
+
+        days_in_month = (
+            31, 29 if year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0) else 28,
+            31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31
+        )
+        if not 1 <= day <= days_in_month[month - 1]:
+            return epoch
+
+        return (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, 0, 0, 0)
